name: mettlespark
description: See what tech roles ask for, which of those skills you have and what to learn next, your best-fit jobs, and a short skill quiz, from the newest job ads in the United States and Canada.

interface.shortDescription: Tech jobs that fit your skills
interface.longDescription: Mettlespark is a career guide for people in tech. Every day it reads tech job ads from employers' own hiring pages in the United States and Canada, and remote roles, and turns them into what each role asks for and where you stand. On mettlespark.com it also reads your CV against the role you want, builds a learning plan for the gaps, and helps you prepare your CV, interviews and applications. In ChatGPT, ask what a role asks for: the most requested skills and how often each appears, the remote share, the stated pay range, and how many ads and employers the figures come from. Ask which of the role's top ten skills you already have and what to learn first, with a page on how to learn each missing skill. Ask for the newest openings for a role, or for a quiz on a skill: three questions from Mettlespark's quiz bank, checked one at a time. Those need no account, and the skill names you compare are used for that answer and dropped. If you have a Mettlespark account you can connect it: then ask which jobs fit you and get your five best matches for your target role, with the skills each ad asks for that you have and are missing, and ask to save one to My jobs. A connected assistant gets job ads and skill names only, never your CV, your email address or your name, and you can disconnect it in Mettlespark under Account. Answers appear as cards where the assistant shows them, name where the figures come from, and link to each job ad, the role's report, the skill pages, and your Openings and My jobs on Mettlespark. It covers 40-odd tech roles, from software, data and machine learning engineers to product managers and analysts.

positive.description: List the roles and countries covered
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the tech roles Mettlespark covers (about 40, such as Data Scientist, Software Engineer, Product Manager) and the places: United States, Canada and Remote.

positive.description: Newest openings for a role in a country
positive.prompt: What are the newest data scientist jobs in Canada?
positive.expected_behavior: Up to five recent Data Scientist openings in Canada or remote roles open there, each with title, employer, place, date posted and a link, plus how many are open and a link to the Data Scientist report.

positive.description: What a role's job ads ask for
positive.prompt: What do machine learning engineer job ads in the United States ask for?
positive.expected_behavior: The most requested skills with the share of ads naming each, the remote share, seniority, median years asked, the stated pay range, and how many ads and employers the figures come from.

positive.prompt: I know Python, SQL and Tableau. What am I missing for data scientist roles in the US?
positive.expected_behavior: Which of the role's top ten skills the person has (Python, SQL) and which are missing, most asked first (such as Machine Learning and Statistics), with a link to learn each missing skill.

positive.prompt: Show me the latest remote software engineer openings.
positive.expected_behavior: Up to five recent remote Software Engineer openings, each with title, employer, place, date posted and a link, and the Software Engineer report.

After the Mettlespark account is connected: up to five open jobs for the account's target role, best first, each with title, employer, place, date, a link, whether it is a top or good match, and the ad's required skills the person has and is missing, plus a link to all their matches in Mettlespark.

positive.description: Save a job to My jobs
positive.prompt: Save the first one to my jobs.
positive.expected_behavior: The job is added to My jobs in the connected Mettlespark account (asking first, as a write), and the answer confirms it with a link to My jobs. Saving it again changes nothing.

positive.description: A short quiz on a skill
positive.expected_behavior: Three multiple-choice SQL questions, one at a time; each answer is checked with quiz_answer, which says whether it was right, which option is, and why.

negative.prompt: What are the newest data scientist jobs in Germany?
negative.expected_behavior: Mettlespark covers only the United States, Canada and remote roles; the answer says so and offers those instead, without inventing German openings.

negative.prompt: Find me the newest nursing jobs in Toronto.
negative.expected_behavior: Nursing isn't among the tech roles Mettlespark covers; the answer says which roles it covers rather than returning unrelated tech jobs.

negative.prompt: Apply to the first data scientist job for me and send them my CV.
negative.expected_behavior: Mettlespark only reads job data; it can't apply or send anything. The answer says so and gives the job's link so the person can apply themselves.

negative.prompt: What's the email address on my Mettlespark account, and show me my CV.
negative.expected_behavior: Mettlespark's connection gives job matches and saving a job only; the answer says the account's details and CV aren't available here and points to Mettlespark.
